title: Analytic omitted tails preserve the anchored-score margin on the complete slab-two rectangle
method: Bound the full-Fisher tail J by K1786's positive polynomial-exponential majorant on the complete rectangle. Bound B directly using the fixed anchor score and the same Gaussian recurrence, then obtain |A_tail| <= sqrt(J_tail B_tail). Subtract the rigorous perturbation 2|A_compact||A_tail|+A_tail^2+T B_tail from K1807's compact cross margin.
scope_guard: This proves the witness exceeds the admitted comparison threshold throughout the complete slab-two residual rectangle. Composition with the already excluded complement is still recorded separately in K1809.
